NEXT SESSION OPTIONS (no carry-over from this one — v1.14 is fully wrapped):
- Write dogfooding Part Three (the strongest case study yet — loop closed, soak policy codified, guardrails from dataset mine).
- Open the v1.15 Phase 1 soak window. Watch for: write-amp warning fires/not (whether the guard moves agent behavior), degraded shed fires (whether 50KB default is right), refusedReason rate (whether agents recover via codex_init or stick with explicit-scope-global). Per project.soakPolicy: 14d cap, day-7 checkpoint, exit gate is >=10 sessions, >=5 namespaces, >=3 projects, >=7 days.
- Triage any post-release surprises that the soak surfaces.

If you start with "what's next" and the soak hasn't been formally opened, the answer is "open it" — file a v1.15 milestone, decide a Phase 1 end-date target. Theme will pick itself once the data accumulates.
